lines.text: What if gravity doubled, every single minute?
How long do you think you'd last?
Minute one. Two G.
You weigh double, like carrying another person on your back.
Birds start falling out of the sky.
Minute two. Four G.
You can't stand anymore. Your heart can't push blood up to your brain, and most people black out right here.
Minute three. Eight G.
Trees snap under their own weight, and cars sink onto their axles.
Minute four. Sixteen G.
Towers were never built for this. They come down, floor by floor.
Minute five. Thirty two G.
That's stronger than the gravity on the surface of the Sun.
The whole city is now a thin layer of rubble.
Minute ten. One thousand G.
Rock itself can't hold its shape. The tallest mountains slump to the height of a house.
Minute seventeen. One hundred thousand G, like the surface of a white dwarf.
Earth crushes itself into a glowing ball, and the Moon starts falling in.
Before minute thirty, Earth collapses completely.
Everything you have ever known, inside a black hole.
So be honest. Would you have made it past minute two?
